name: Běrunice (Czechia)
description: Divided diagonally from the lower hoist to the upper fly into a blue hoist half and a red fly half, with a white cockerel with yellow crown and beak standing on a yellow hunting horn in the blue, and three white and red crescents in the red.
history: Granted by decision of the Chairman of the Chamber of Deputies of the Czech Parliament on 19 November 2009 and entered in the Register of Municipal Symbols (REKOS); the flag repeats the colours and charges of the municipal arms.
